response.overview: The story follows Cempaka (Uqasha Senrose) who is forced to inherit a family curse after her mother's death. The dark inheritance originates from her grandmother, Nek Ros (Didie Alias), and was passed down to her mother. To end this mystical pact, Cempaka must perform four rituals, each connected to marriage and promising extraordinary rewards. Cempaka's dark journey begins when her marriages to Faris (Yusuf Bahrin), Jeffrey (Shahz Jaszle) and Armand (Keith Foo) open the door to various mysterious disturbances and secrets that haunt their lives. Although initially reluctant, Cempaka is eventually tempted by the promises contained in the Book of Inheritance. However, as the disturbances become increasingly difficult to control, she reunites with her first love, Ikmal (Nafiz Muaz), who appears when she needs help the most. Cempaka (Uqasha Senrose) is willing to do anything to support her younger sister, Aliya (Kiky Hannah) and keep her family together.
